label: ASPSCR1::TFE3

sections.text: ASPSCR1 encodes a trafficking protein involved in intracellular GLUT4 transport.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 79058 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: TFE3 encodes an E-box-binding transcription factor.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 7030 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: ASPSCR1::TFE3 acts as an oncogenic transcriptional regulator in alveolar soft part sarcoma: fusion-degradation experiments alter cell-cycle, mitochondrial and angiogenic expression programs. The fusion also occurs in TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma.

audit_evidence.location: Results: ASPSCR1::TFE3 supports cell cycle, mitochondrial and angiogenic expression; Figure 4
audit_evidence.scope: Fusion degradation, RNA-seq and target regulation in ASPS models; direct transcriptional activity.

audit_evidence.location: Results: Transcriptome features of ASPSCR1-TFE3 rRCC; Figure 2
audit_evidence.scope: RNA-seq-defined ASPSCR1-TFE3 renal carcinoma subgroup; used here only for tumor association, not treatment recommendation.

sections.text: Atezolizumab is US-approved for unresectable or metastatic alveolar soft part sarcoma from age 2 years. This histology-specific indication does not extend to TFE3-rearranged renal carcinoma.

audit_evidence.scope: Adults and pediatric patients age 2 and older with unresectable or metastatic ASPS.
